Per rule 11.7.1.c/e/f, accent marks and periods on abbreviations are omitted without a transcriber's note: "prép." becomes "prep" (no accent, no period), "masc. sg." becomes "masc sg" (no periods), "à"/"às" appear without their accent grave, matching rule 11.7.1.e (punctuation may be omitted) applied silently.

uncertain: Whether the missing accent marks (e.g. in 'a', 'a') in the braille are because literary braille has no distinct accented-letter cells in this technical-French context, or because they were omitted per some other rule, was not resolved -- recorded as transcribed, not re-derived.
